description: This file defines the AnyOf validation rule class, which is a composite validation rule that extends an abstract composite class. It is part of the validation rules for the API version 2 of the OrangeHRM Core plugin, specifically within the composite rules set.

classes.name: AnyOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that extends AbstractComposite, representing a composite validation rule for 'any of' conditions, utilizing the Respect Validation library.

methods.name: getRuleClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the scalar validation rule from the Respect Validation library that this composite rule encapsulates.
